notes: Test build: setup can't leave a TV without a home screen, works on TVs with long tidy-up lists (TCL), keeps your own Private DNS when ad blocking is turned off, and never changes anything it can't undo. Sideload shows what an app can use and warns about home screens. Sliders move straight away, menus are easier to read, the glow follows the wallpaper by default, and the phone page checks the PIN first.
